{{Top|leg}}
'''Dellio''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dellio integrated a [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] pack into their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] communications system. The last time Dellio was boarded by customs officials, the jammer pack was activated and disrupted communications. Dellio escaped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] while the crew took out the boarders.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
